newsitem.title: UK: East Midlands Electricity bid talk lifts sector.
newsitem.headline: East Midlands Electricity bid talk lifts sector.

text.p: Regional electricity shares were given a boost on Friday by rumours of a possible bid for East Midlands Electricity by an American utilities company.
Shares in East Midlands jumped 19-1/2p to 537-1/2p in a buoyant sector after press reports that Houston Industries could bid around 750p a share for the company as soon as next week.
"There could well be another takeover before the election," said one utilities analyst who declined to be named.
"But we have no idea who it could be... this is pure speculation," he added.
Others in the sector rose on the back of the bid talk.
London Electric was up 11-1/2p at 575p by 0920 GMT. Northern Electric added 10p to 508p and Yorkshire Electricity was up 12-1/2p at 725p.
Traders said East Midlands had been picked out as the favourite for a bid approach. American company Duke Power was mentioned as another possible bidder in today's press.
"If there were a bid around 750p a share," said one analyst. "It doesn't sound too outrageous."
